# MEMELAND Advisory Board

The Advisory Board comprises experts from a wide range of disciplines.

## Members

### Dr. Kim Cohen

- 🏦Researcher, Department of Physical Geography, Utrecht University
- 🔬Research focus: Quaternary geology and the Holocene Rhine-Meuse delta, combining geological and geographical methods for landscape reconstruction
- 📬email: k.m.cohen(at)uu.nl

### Professor Eugene Costello <img src="https://en.uit.no/Content/931211/transformation=scale10000x800/PV%20ECostello%2072_Cr.JPG" align="right" width="120"/>

- 🏦Environmental historian and landscape archaeologist, University College Cork
- 🔬Research focus: farming practices, environmental and economic change, and the ERC DeepCattle project on commercial cattle farming in Europe
- 📬email: ecostello(at)ucc.ie

### Prof. Dr. Wim De Clercq <img src="https://en.uit.no/Content/931173/cache=1781092188000/Wim%20De%20Clercq-Kirst%20van%20der%20Vorst%20Agentschap%20Onroerend%20Erfgoed.PNG" align="right" width="120"/>

- 🏦Professor, Ghent University; Historical Archaeology Research Group (HARG)
- 🔬Research focus: landscape archaeology, settlement development, and material culture in northwestern Europe, particularly medieval landscape change around Bruges
- 📬email: w.declercq(at)ugent.be

### Professor Mark Gardiner <img src="https://en.uit.no/Content/931166/transformation=scale10000x180/Mark%20Gardiner.png" align="right" width="120"/>

- 🏦Emeritus Professor of Medieval Archaeology, University of Lincoln
- 🔬Research focus: medieval landscapes, land use, and settlement patterns in Britain, Ireland, and the North Atlantic, especially links between land use and social organisation
- 📬email: mgardiner(at)lincoln.ac.uk

### Dr. Jorn Erik Henriksen <img src="https://en.uit.no/Content/931163/cache=1781092045000/J%C3%B8rn%20Erik%20Henriksen.jpg" align="right" width="120"/>

- 🏦Associate Professor of Archaeology, Arctic University Museum of Norway (UiT)
- 🔬Research focus: Iron Age and Medieval periods in Northern Norway
- 📬email: jorn.henriksen(at)uit.no

### Dr. W.Z. Hoek <img src="https://en.uit.no/Content/931174/cache=1781092198000/WimHoek.jpg" align="right" width="120"/>

- 🏦Researcher, Department of Physical Geography, Utrecht University
- 🔬Research focus: Late Weichselian and Holocene climate, vegetation, and landscape interactions, including multi-proxy analyses and dating of lake sediment records
- 📬email: W.Z.Hoek(at)uu.nl

### Professor Richard C Hoffmann <img src="https://en.uit.no/Content/931169/cache=1781092133000/Richard%20Hoffmann.jpeg" align="right" width="120"/>

- 🏦Professor Emeritus and Senior Scholar, York University
- 🔬Research focus: interdisciplinary environmental history of fisheries, agroecosystems, and natural resource use in medieval Europe
